summary: The team discussed the Kubernetes memory issue and planned to migrate the PostgreSQL database to a managed instance by Friday. They considered switching the CI/CD pipeline to GitHub Actions but postponed the decision. They decided to implement OAuth with JWT tokens for the new login API. An open need was identified to update the Swagger documentation.
